title: NxDiscord
description: A simple plugin that sends your server’s Discord link using the /discord command.
body:
NxDiscord is a lightweight and simple plugin that lets players instantly get your server’s Discord link using the /discord command. Perfect for any Minecraft server that wants to share their community invite fast and clean.

✨ Features:
• Sends your Discord link with /discord  
• Fully customizable message  
• Works on all Spigot/Paper versions  
• Extremely lightweight and lag-free  

⚙️ Command:
• /discord — Sends the configured Discord link

📁 Config Preview:
discord-message: "&aJoin our Discord: &bhttps://dc.gg/nxdevelopment"
